name: Magma Dragon, Very Young
body:
Magma Dragon, Very Young
CR 6

Between this dragon’s jet-black scales run glowing rivulets of lava, and veins aglow with heat shine in the membranes of its wings.

XP 2,400
CN Small dragon (fire)
Init +6; Senses dragon senses; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 13, flat-footed 18 (+2 Dex, +7 natural, +1 size)
hp 59 (7d12+14)
Fort +9, Ref +7, Will +9
Immune fire, paralysis, sleep
Weaknesses vulnerable to cold

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)
Melee bite +11 (1d6+4), 2 claws +11 (1d4+3)
Special Attacks breath weapon (20-ft. cone, 4d6 fire, DC 15)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +8)

At will—burning hands (DC 12)

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 14, Con 15, Int 14, Wis 14, Cha 13
Base Atk +7; CMB +9; CMD 21 (25 vs. trip)
Feats Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack
Skills Acrobatics +9 (+13 jump), Climb +13, Fly +14, Intimidate +11, Perception +12, Sense Motive +12, Stealth +16, Swim +13
Languages Common, Draconic, Ignan

ECOLOGY

Environment any mountains or underground (Plane of Fire)
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

Temperamental and prone to violent outbursts, magma dragons are regarded by most other dragons as dangerously insane—an assumption that, more often than not, proves correct. One can rarely predict a magma dragon’s state of mind until it either attacks or attempts to engage in conversation. For their part, magma dragons can justify all of their actions—they just rarely feel the need to do so.
